steps.content:
They're both selling the **exact same headphones** - Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones in graphite:

* Same specs - 40hr battery with ANC on, Bluetooth 5.3, 254g, USB-C + 3.5mm in the box
* Same rating: 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
* Same shipping: In stock, Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days
* Same warranty: 1-year limited warranty

The only differences are price vs. returns:

**A - Brackmoor Sound - $129.00**
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/w7eqev/a
* Returns: 30-day returns. **Buyer pays return shipping.** Refund to original payment method.

**B - Ottervale Audio - $142.00**
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/w7eqev/b
* Returns: **Free 90-day returns.** Refund to original payment method.

### Buy from B - Ottervale Audio

For most people, it's worth paying the $13 extra (~10% more).

Headphones are very fit/comfort dependent, and Ottervale gives you 3x longer to try them - 90 days vs 30 days - **and** you don't have to pay return shipping if you don't like them. Return shipping on over-ears can easily eat up most of that $13 savings from Brackmoor.

Buy from A - Brackmoor Sound - only if you are 100% sure you'll keep them and just want the lowest upfront price at $129.
